title: The Leaked Blue Ribbon Chili
intro: Someone has spilled the secret spice blend of the county fair's prize-winning chili, and the judges want to know who talked.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I only tasted it once. Okay, twice. Maybe three times.

suspects.name: Teddy
suspects.line: I came for the funnel cake. The chili was just a bonus.

suspects.name: Otis
suspects.line: I was judging the pie contest. Pie is a very serious business.

suspects.name: Rosa
suspects.line: Thirty-one years I've been at this fair. Nobody steals from me.

suspects.name: Marlon
suspects.line: My hands are clean. Ask anyone who's seen me hold a corn dog.

clues.text: Yellow mustard stains dot the napkin pile here, but they are not from the leak. Nobody who handled this mustard touched the spice blend.
A smear of red chili stains marks the spoon that was dipped in the secret pot. Whoever stirred it last left a bright red trail.
Someone was clearly sipping lemonade near the pot, but a sticky cup proves it was not the leaker, who never drank a drop.
A pair of blue latex gloves sits folded in the bin, still clean. The person who wore them did not handle the spice blend.
